Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and sometimes fully vegetarian menus). All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews for both food quality and service.

> **Tip:**  
> • Call ahead or check the restaurant’s website for the most up‑to‑date vegetarian menu options.  
> • Many of these places offer “vegetarian” or “vegan” labels on their menus, but it’s always good to confirm if you have dietary restrictions.  
> • If you’re looking for a fully vegetarian or vegan Thai experience, consider restaurants that specifically advertise a vegetarian menu (e.g., *Baan Thai* and *Thai Orchid*).

Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
